title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, Web UI, and MCP server to find code patterns and reusable components across a user's portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend using sentence-transformers for embeddings and SQLite-vec for vector storage. FastAPI serves the REST API. The web frontend is static HTML/JS consuming JSON data exported by the CLI. AWS Lambda handles OAuth and logging. GitHub Actions automate weekly reindexing.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, install dependencies, configure a GitHub token, index your repos using the CLI, and serve the web UI or integrate the MCP server into AI agents like Claude Code.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories
MCP server integration for AI agent access
Static web UI with faceted filtering and autocomplete
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable search results and shareable URLs
